title: New Discs Data Pack
description: This data pack makes the music discs a certain length for our "New Discs" Resource Pack.
body: This data pack makes all the music discs the perfect length so they don't cut off mid-song. This is made for our New Discs Resource Pack, please download that first here: [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/new-discs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/new-discs) Go into gallery to see how to download this pack.
